title: QUIC RFC 9000 STREAM Frame Focused Proof Work Item
summary: Decompose RFC 9000 S19P8 STREAM frame proof into focused requirement-home tests and canonical trace evidence.
planned_changes:
- Add S19P8 stream-frame test support for exact byte construction, declared-length mismatch cases, parse rejection assertions, and formatter round-trip checks.
- Add focused positive, negative, and edge requirement-home tests for STREAM frame type bits, Stream ID, Offset, Length, FIN, Stream Data consumption, max-offset boundaries, and invalid stream target receive-state errors.
- Update canonical S19P8 xrefs and generated coverage triage.
verification_plan: Run the focused S19P8 requirement-home filter, run the supporting stream parser/fuzz filter, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, run a Release build, and validate SpecTrace JSON.
out_of_scope: Completing other RFC 9000 S19 frame families.
Changing packet-level close emission policy for parser failures.
Claiming interop readiness beyond the focused STREAM frame proof.
completion_notes: Completed as focused proof decomposition over existing STREAM parser, formatter, and receive-side stream-state behavior.
